# realpath

Published version: `cli/realpath@0.1.6`. See the release inventory;
[latest.json](../../tests/release/latest.json) records the uploaded coordinates.

Canonicalize paths for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/realpath@0.1.6 [OPTION]... NAME...
```

## Supported scope

Resolve paths physically or lexically, with existing/missing component modes and relative output. Default permits a missing final component.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-e` / `--canonicalize-existing` | none | require every component to exist |
| `-m` / `--canonicalize-missing` | none | allow missing or non-directory components |
| `-E` / `--canonicalize` | none | allow a missing final component (default) |
| `-s` / `--strip` | none | do not expand symbolic links |
| `--no-symlinks` | none | do not expand symbolic links |
| `-q` / `--quiet` | none | suppress operand errors |
| `-z` / `--zero` | none | terminate output with NUL |
| `--relative-to` | required | print relative to DIR |
| `--relative-base` | required | use relative output only inside DIR |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Argument and exit-status contract

Ordinary option/operand errors exit 1; documented capability refusals retain their own status.

See the [finite diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics).

## Limitations

- Physical resolution fails when a symbolic link cannot be expanded; -ms processes that spelling lexically.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/realpath@0.1.6 -e input.txt
moonx cli/realpath@0.1.6 -ms path/../new.txt
```
